comments.DOCKER_HOST_note: Platform-specific Docker configuration is handled automatically by PlatformConfiguration.ConfigureDockerEnvironment() in ModuleInitializer. Do not set DOCKER_HOST here on macOS/Linux as it overrides automatic detection.
comments.windows: On Windows: DOCKER_HOST will be set to 'npipe://./pipe/docker_engine' automatically
comments.macos_linux: On macOS/Linux: DOCKER_HOST remains unset to use Unix socket default (/var/run/docker.sock)
